# Pooja Verma

> AI developer and machine learning researcher in Kamloops, British Columbia,
> Canada, and a computing science student at Thompson Rivers University (TRU).
> She builds retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, evaluates and
> fine-tunes large language models, trains machine learning models for
> research, and ships full-stack and data products. Open to AI development
> projects, applied ML research, grant-funded work and collaborations across
> British Columbia and Canada.

Site: https://www.poojaverma.ca
Last updated: September 2026

## Contact her for
- AI and machine learning development in Kamloops, the BC Interior, British
  Columbia or anywhere in Canada, in person or remote.
- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM evaluation, prompt and benchmark
  design, and RLHF data work.
- Applied ML research, including grant-funded and university research at
  Thompson Rivers University (UREAP, sustainability grants, Mitacs).
- Full-stack web products, data pipelines and Salesforce or Power Platform
  automation.
- Email: pooja32verma@gmail.com

## Experience
- Junior Research Intern, Mitacs Business Strategy Internship, PataBid
  (January to September 2026): owned a high-performance PDF rendering engine
  for a construction estimating platform and the pipelines behind automated
  stamp and take-off detection.
- Undergraduate Student Researcher, TRU Sustainability Research Grant (April
  2026 to present): AI-driven post-wildfire ecosystem recovery.
- Generative AI Data Specialist, Outlier (October 2025 to present): designs
  coding benchmarks and multi-turn reasoning prompts used to fine-tune frontier
  LLMs through RLHF, and red-teams reasoning for hallucination resistance.
  Previously Tier-3 Programmer Analyst there (2024 to 2025).
- Research Assistant, TRU (May to July 2025): built a RAG study assistant used
  by 3,000+ students, improving answer relevance by 40%.
- UREAP Undergraduate Researcher, TRU (April to November 2025): CNN-based
  diabetic retinopathy detection.
- Programmer Analyst Co-op, BC Lottery Corporation (May 2024 to January 2025):
  Salesforce (Apex, LWC) and Power Platform work for 4,000+ retailers and an
  employee check-in platform for 1,000+ staff; cut manual licensing work 30%.
- Teaching Assistant (three terms) and Research Coach at TRU, mentoring 150+
  students in Python, Java, data structures, web development and research
  methods.

## Research and awards
- AI-Driven Post-Wildfire Ecosystem Recovery. TRU Student Sustainability
  Research Grant ($2,500). LightGBM at 0.707 weighted F1 over six merged
  environmental datasets; presented at the TRU Sustainability Conference.
- Automated Diabetic Retinopathy Detection from fundus images with CNNs.
  UREAP Research Award ($6,000).
